verdict.rationale: Postman docs state that without signing in you can still use a 'lightweight API client' to send requests (postman-docs-34, postman-docs-53), suggesting some offline capability, but this is limited (no full workspace, collections, sync) and multiple community reports describe Postman increasingly requiring cloud login, uploading data to servers, and even losing local workspace data (postman-comm-1, postman-comm-2, postman-comm-4, postman-comm-9, postman-comm-12), directly contradicting the idea of a fully offline local workspace experience. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a persistent local-only workspace mode, confirmation that collections/environments can be created and saved without any account, and independent verification that no telemetry/cloud sync occurs.
